scientific_integrity: Classical coupling, Borel-Cantelli, martingale, Hellinger-type equivalence principles, and triangular CLT tools are credited; no claim is made to solving the general nonsummability question.
scientific_limitations: Only positive row seeds and positive initial probabilities; exact parabolic one-simplex family and its associated nonhomogeneous two-state chain. The analytic conclusions are not independently validated. Full priority across unindexed literature remains uncertain.
title: Parabolic stochastic dynamics: full path-measure classes and a critical rare-visit window
